gallery.description:
Scope and content:  This item lists Enumeration Districts for:
IL ED 54-13A: EAST LINCOLN TOWNSHIP, LINCOLN CITY WARD 3 BOUNDED BY (N) ILLINOIS CENTRAL RAILROAD; (E) MCLEAN; (S) PULASKI, ALTON RAILROAD, PEKIN; (W) KANKAKEE.
IL ED 54-13B: EAST LINCOLN TOWNSHIP, LINCOLN CITY WARD 3 BOUNDED BY (N) CITY LIMITS; (E) CITY LIMITS; (S) MCLEAN; (W) ILLINOIS CENTRAL RAILROAD.
IL ED 54-14: EAST LINCOLN TOWNSHIP, LINCOLN CITY COMPRISING WARD 4 BOUNDED BY (N) CITY LIMITS; (E) ILLINOIS CENTRAL RAILROAD; (S) KANKAKEE, PEKIN, ALTON RAILROAD, BROADWAY; (W) TOWNSHIP LINE; ALSO LINCOLN COLLEGE DORMITORY.
IL ED 54-15: EAST LINCOLN TOWNSHIP, LINCOLN CITY WARD 5 BOUNDED BY (N) BROADWAY; (E) ALTON RAILROAD; (S) PULASKI, KANKAKEE; (W) TOWNSHIP LINE.

IL ED 54-16: WEST LINCOLN TOWNSHIP, LINCOLN CITY WARD 5 BOUNDED BY (N) CITY LIMITS; (E) TOWNSHIP LINE; (S) 6TH; (W) PINE, 8TH, ELM, 17TH, CITY LIMITS; ALSO EVANGELICAL DEACONESS HOME AND HOSPITAL.
